publicationRule: Unity Publish CURRENT must copy the exact verified EMOTIONAL_DIALOGUE_CURRENT.json artifact to open-current/EMOTIONAL_DIALOGUE_CURRENT.json. DEVORA and Simple Preview read only this direct mirror during normal page load. They do not open the large CURRENT ZIP and do not fetch GitHub Release assets to discover dialogue readiness.

identitySemantics.actorId: Exact curated participant id. Must equal CUTSCENE_SCRIPT_V1 cast[].id and dialogue speaker/listener values with case-sensitive equality.
identitySemantics.identityHandle: Stable logical Emotional Dialogue identity published by Unity. Must match with case-sensitive equality. It is not Actor Catalog identity and not Ui/portrait identity.
identitySemantics.presentation: FullPortrait presentation comes from the same curated CharacterPack and never creates identity. defaultPresentationHandle is Unity's exact published GUID:localFileId asset identity.

atomicityRules: The mirror status must be CURRENT_VERIFIED_EMOTIONAL_DIALOGUE.
The mirror publishTransactionId must equal current.json and OPEN_CURRENT.json.
All five requiredCurrent fingerprints must equal current.json and OPEN_CURRENT.json.
Missing, stale or mismatched mirror disables dialogue only; non-dialogue authoring remains available.
preJsonGate: If the request contains dialogue, load open-current/EMOTIONAL_DIALOGUE_CURRENT.json before generating JSON.
If the repertoire is missing, stale, non-atomic, unverified or has zero authoringReady characters, stop before JSON and state that dialogue authoring is disabled.
If the user requests a character absent from the authoringReady repertoire, stop before JSON, state that the requested dialogue character is unavailable and list only the available repertoire.
Never silently substitute a different dialogue character.
forbiddenDiscoveryPaths: CURRENT bundle extraction during page boot
GitHub Release asset fetch during page boot
lineRules: speaker and listener are exact case-sensitive actorId values and must have exact matching cast[].id entries.
The matching cast entry identityHandle must equal the character identityHandle with case-sensitive equality.
If expressionIntent is absent, null, empty or whitespace-only, Unity uses the published defaultExpression.
If expressionIntent is present and nonblank, it must exactly and case-sensitively match one supportedExpressions value for that speaker.
Unsupported expressions are blockers. There is no Neutral fallback and no portrait search.
Listener presentation uses the listener's published defaultExpression unless a future CURRENT contract explicitly exposes listener expression authoring.
Dialogue presentation preview may use only the repertoire defaultPresentationHandle for identity evidence; it must never resolve a dialogue portrait through general AUTHORING_HANDLES.
